summary: CDW LLC and CDW Finance Corp, units of CDW Corp, priced a $1.5 billion three-tranche senior unsecured note offering via a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement: $600M 5.700% notes due 2029, $500M 6.100% notes due 2032, and $400M 6.350% notes due 2033. Net proceeds, about $1.49 billion after $8.2M underwriting discounts, will redeem or retire $1.0 billion of 2.670% senior notes due December 2026, with the balance for general corporate purposes, including funding a substantial portion of an unspecified Acquisition. Guaranteed by CDW Corporation; unsecured, effectively subordinated to secured debt and inventory financing.
